context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 verified the pot/admin router refactoring: (1) state/pot_state.py provides shared pot state via get_pot(), reset_pot(), update_pot(). (2) routers/pot.py handles GET /api/betting/pot and POST /api/betting/pot/join with proper validation. (3) routers/admin.py handles GET /api/admin/check/{wallet}, GET /api/admin/dashboard, GET /api/admin/challenges, POST /api/admin/pot/draw with authorization.
